WELCOME

Jesus Christ is at the center.

Rock House 49 is presented as a youth-focused Christian ministry serving Oklahoma City and surrounding areas. Ministry services include evangelistic preaching, youth services and revivals, prophetic ministry, prayer and altar services, deliverance ministry, and community outreach.

“I'm a nobody that met a somebody—His name is JESUS CHRIST!”

THE MESSAGE

Called, Chosen & Set Apart

Inspired by Acts 2:38 and Luke 3:16, we proclaim the message of repentance, baptism, and the work of the Holy Spirit. We believe God calls His people to follow Jesus Christ, walk in obedience, and seek the fire and power of the Holy Spirit.

Walking Under the Anointing of Jesus Christ

Our heart is to point people to Jesus Christ—the One who saves, delivers, heals, and fills His people with the Holy Spirit. We believe a true calling is demonstrated through faithfulness to Christ, the Word of God, prayer, service, and the fruit of a surrendered life.

Acts 2:38: a call to repent, be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ, and receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

Luke 3:16: Jesus is the One who baptizes with the Holy Spirit and fire.
